constants.name: SLIPPAGE_MULTIPLIER
constants.source: adverse-fill assumption, half-spread, no empirical fit

constants.source: conservative uniform floor; replaces legacy max(computed,1.0)

constants.name: SLIPPAGE_CEILING_BPS

constants.name: GAS_USD_FALLBACK
constants.source: Base L2 execution cost, live oracle preferred

constants.name: FAILED_ATTEMPT_USD
constants.source: Not charged. Memo-trading paper fills assume every entry fills; charging for failures would be pessimistic but the failure rate is unmeasured. Once paper fills exist this becomes a real constant, not a guess.
